messages:
Lydia Park: Heads-up: SunLeaf (reseller) applied a retro rebate on INV-2026-0772 that wasn't in their partner schedule. Customer asked for clarification / correction. @Omar Rahman @Tess Nguyen
Omar Rahman: can you paste the invoice lines and rebate code?
Lydia Park: copy paste:
INV-2026-0772
- Dedicated reserved GPUs (eu-central) 1,600 hrs @ $0.45 = $972.00
- Reseller rebate (applied) 'SL-Q1RETRO' = -$145.80 (15%)
- Net billed = $826.20
Partner contract: SL-PART-2025 says reseller margin = 8% on committed reserved plans. No retro rebates allowed after month close.
Billing Bot: Auto-validate: rebate code not authorized for SunLeaf, applied via partner upload. Flagged FIN-3415. Suggested remedy: issue credit to customer if overcharged, and debit partner settlement.
Tess Nguyen: quick calc  if partner should have applied 8% margin then the allowed discount = $77.76. Currently $145.80 applied. Over-applied discount = $68.04.
Omar Rahman: thanks Tess. So customer actually benefit was larger; we need to reverse the excess rebate (issue credit to our revenue as negative credit?). Wait, customer paid less than they should have; correction means we owe them nothing but need to adjust partner pay?
Lydia Park: right — customer's invoice net is lower due to partner error. We need to issue an adjustment to partner settlement for $68.04 and create a memo for the partner. No customer-facing credit necessary since customer paid less; instead we should send a clarification and correct the partner payout so we retain correct revenue.
Billing Bot: Recommended actions: 1) Create partner adjustment ADJ-2026-2201 for $68.04 to be deducted from next partner payout; 2) Send explanatory note to SunLeaf and the end-customer.
Omar Rahman: approve ADJ-2026-2201. @Tess can you draft partner note?
Tess Nguyen: Draft: "SunLeaf: During partner sync a retro rebate code SL-Q1RETRO was applied incorrectly to INV-2026-0772. Per contract SL-PART-2025, allowed partner margin is 8%. We will deduct $68.04 from your next settlement to correct the over-applied rebate. Please review your partner upload process to prevent future backdated rebates." Thoughts?
Lydia Park: keep it factual and include settlement reference. Also add timeline: deduction will appear on payout dated 2026-03-15.
Tess Nguyen: updated note includes settlement reference and date.
Omar Rahman: creating partner adjustment now:
```
/create-partner-adjust --partner SunLeaf --inv INV-2026-0772 --amt 68.04 --ref ADJ-2026-2201 --reason "unauthorized retro rebate"
```
System: ADJ-2026-2201 created; FIN-3415 updated; partner ops assigned.
Billing Bot: Log note added to invoice record; recommend follow-up audit on partner sync. Creating OPS ticket OPS-1122.
Lydia Park: I'll send the customer-facing clarification after ADJ posts. Marking this thread for follow-up.
Omar Rahman: thanks all. Leaving a postmortem tag for partner ops to review retro rebate rules. :white_check_mark:
